name: oasis-artifact-security
prerequisites: Exact artifact inventory/hashes, project acceptance policy and an available approved scanner. Hash lookup and uploading bytes have distinct authority.

scenarios.trigger: Acknowledged analysis finishes for identical bytes
scenarios.expected: Reuse its report under current configured freshness/criteria.
Stop before upload or acceptance and bind a new candidate.

scenarios.trigger: POST timed out before analysis ID persisted
scenarios.expected: Inspect existing service state; never automatically POST again.
